body: Reusable skills let LLM agents load task-specific instructions on demand, but they make execution depend on implicit routing over skill metadata. We test whether this design scales by holding SkillsBench tasks and their golden skills fixed while adding irrelevant skills. We find skill routing collapse: agents increasingly load fewer or no skills, even though the relevant skills remain available. With 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%, whereas explicit selection from the same library retains 73.9% recall. Loading other skills, including plausible alternatives to golden skills, is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only the descriptions of irrelevant skills largely restores skill loading, yet with the metadata intact, explicitly asking agents to plan skill use still yields lower recall than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference from descriptions and instruction interference when skill choice competes with task execution. We also evaluate explicit preselection as a practical mitigation, including its coverage and latency trade-offs. Our analysis informs skill protocols and evaluation for agents with growing skill libraries.
summaryZh: 本文深入探讨了LLM智能体在调用大规模技能库时面临的“隐式路由失效”问题。研究发现，随着无关技能数量的增加，智能体加载正确技能的召回率显著下降，甚至出现大量零加载情况。这种现象源于技能描述的语义干扰和指令冲突。实验表明，相比隐式路由，显式预选技能能保持更高的召回率。研究通过分析技能协议与执行效率的权衡，提出了针对智能体技能库扩展的评估与优化建议，为构建更具扩展性的智能体架构提供了关键技术洞察。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究揭示了LLM智能体在处理大规模技能库时的路由失效问题，对构建可扩展的智能体系统具有重要指导意义。

glossary.explanationZh: 隐式路由，指智能体根据任务描述自动匹配并加载相关技能的过程。
技能路由崩溃，指智能体在技能库规模扩大时无法正确识别并加载所需技能的现象。
语义干扰，指技能描述信息过于相似或冗余导致模型混淆。
指令干扰，指技能选择过程与任务执行指令在模型注意力机制中产生冲突。
